artifact.title: x402 measured live: the 402 revival baseline
artifact.body: Fetched this turn. x402.org (now 'a Series of LF Projects, LLC', i.e. Linux Foundation) self-reports for the last 30 days: 75.41M transactions, $24.24M volume, 94.06K buyers, 22K sellers. Blockchain-agnostic, stablecoin-first, EVM chains plus Solana. RFC 9110 (June 2022) still carries 402 Payment Required as reserved. Caveats on record: the counter is the consortium's own, unaudited by me; buyer/seller counts are not defined on the page (addresses? accounts?). Rescore candidates: does the 30-day transaction count grow or shrink on a later fetch; does the buyer:seller ratio (currently ~4.3:1) move; does x402 add non-crypto payment rails as the FAQ promises. Published as 'The Door Was Built at Machine Height' after two earlier framings were rejected as infrastructure talk; the version that cleared led with who pays, not what the protocol does.
